aboutGame.title: What is Guns of Eschaton?
paragraphs: Guns of Eschaton is a gun-driven soulslike FPS set in a post-apocalyptic Western wasteland. You build a survivor, choose a loadout, and fight through escalating enemy waves where positioning, ammo economy, and timing matter more than raw firepower.

Every run follows the same loop: clear a wave, collect what drops, convert it into upgrades, then face a harder arena or a boss that tests your pattern recognition. Our wiki breaks down weapons, builds, bosses, modes, and progression so you can plan each run instead of guessing.

modules.description: Learn the core loop, movement, weapon choices, and upgrade priorities that keep your first hours alive. Targets searches such as how to play Guns of Eschaton and starter tips.

highlights.detail: Learn the run loop: choose a loadout, clear enemies, collect drops, then upgrade.
Treat movement as your main defense: strafe, keep an exit, and reload behind cover.
Pick a weapon for the problem in front of you instead of chasing raw damage.
Spend early upgrades on staying alive, not on chasing a perfect build.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Guns of Eschaton.

items.question: What is Guns of Eschaton?
items.answer: Guns of Eschaton is a gun-driven soulslike FPS set in a post-apocalyptic Western wasteland. You build a survivor, pick a loadout, and fight through escalating enemy waves where positioning, ammo economy, and timing matter more than raw firepower.

items.question: How should beginners start Guns of Eschaton?
items.answer: Start with the core loop: learn to move, learn your weapon's rhythm, and spend your first upgrades on staying alive. The Guns of Eschaton beginner guide covers controls, combat, and early progression in detail.

items.question: What platforms is Guns of Eschaton on?
items.answer: Store listings point to PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox, and a playable demo lets you test the game before launch.

items.question: Is there a Guns of Eschaton release date?
items.answer: No launch day is independently confirmed yet. Wishlist the game on your storefront and watch the official pages, which is where a final date will appear first.

items.question: Does Guns of Eschaton have co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Guns of Eschaton co-op turns a run into a shared survival puzzle where roles, revives, and reload timing have to be coordinated with your squad.
